hook: Some things are up to you. Most aren't.
caption:
Some things are up to you. Most aren't.

Marcus Aurelius ruled through plague, war and betrayal, and still came back to this one rule.

Write down one thing you're carrying today that isn't yours to carry.

#stoicism #marcusaurelius #dichotomyofcontrol #stoic #mindset #selfimprovement #philosophy #dailystoic

Someone disrespected you today?

The Stoic test: if it's true, why be angry at the truth? If it's false, it's their mistake, not yours. Based on Epictetus.

Send this to someone who needs it.

#stoicism #epictetus #stoic #mentalstrength #mindset #selfimprovement #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: Marcus Aurelius did this every night. It takes 5 minutes.
caption:
Marcus Aurelius did this every night. It takes 5 minutes.

What did I do well? Where did I fall short? What will I do differently tomorrow?

Try it tonight and tell me which question was hardest. Save this for later.

#stoicism #journaling #marcusaurelius #selfimprovement #nightroutine #stoic #mindset #dailystoic

3 Stoic rules for overthinkers.

1. Ask if it's up to you. If not, it isn't yours to carry.
2. Name the worst case. Seneca did, and it's usually survivable.
3. Do the next small thing. Thought ends where action starts.

Save this for the next 2am spiral.

#stoicism #overthinking #seneca #stoic #anxiety #mindset #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: Not every insult deserves a reply.
caption:
Not every insult deserves a reply.

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 6.6: "The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury." Silence isn't weakness. It's control.

Send this to someone who needs it.

#stoicism #marcusaurelius #selfcontrol #stoic #mentalstrength #mindset #philosophy #dailystoic

Motivation isn't coming.

The emperor of Rome didn't want to get out of bed either. So he wrote himself a reminder: you have work to do as a human being. He didn't wait to feel ready. Neither should you.

Save this for tomorrow morning.

#stoicism #marcusaurelius #discipline #stoic #morningroutine #motivation #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: 5 things you can't control: what they think of you, the past, other people's choices, the weather, the outcome.
caption:
5 things you can't control: what they think of you, the past, other people's choices, the weather, the outcome.

5 things you can: your effort, your words, your response, your habits, your attention.

Epictetus opened his handbook with this: "Some things are up to us, and some are not."

Save this.

#stoicism #epictetus #dichotomyofcontrol #stoic #mindset #anxiety #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: Marcus Aurelius said this to himself every morning, before he saw anyone.
caption:
Marcus Aurelius said this to himself every morning, before he saw anyone.

Not to hate people. To stop being surprised by them. Expect the worst, stay kind anyway, and nobody gets to ruin your day. From Meditations 2.1.

Save this for tomorrow morning.

#stoicism #marcusaurelius #morningroutine #stoic #mindset #selfimprovement #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: The fastest way to lose an argument? Get angry.
caption:
The fastest way to lose an argument? Get angry.

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 11.18: "How much more grievous are the consequences of anger than the causes of it." Pause. Breathe. Answer later. Whoever stays calm stays in control.

Send this to someone with a short fuse.

#stoicism #marcusaurelius #anger #stoic #selfcontrol #mindset #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: You can't make everyone like you.
caption:
You can't make everyone like you.

Epictetus, Enchiridion 13: "If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish and stupid." Their approval isn't the goal. Your character is.

Send this to a people pleaser.

#stoicism #epictetus #peoplepleaser #stoic #confidence #mindset #philosophy #dailystoic

Busy all day. Nothing done.

Seneca, On the Shortness of Life: "It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it." You guard your money. Guard your hours harder.

Follow for more Stoic rules.

#stoicism #seneca #productivity #stoic #timemanagement #mindset #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: It's not what happened that hurts. It's the story you tell about it.
caption:
It's not what happened that hurts. It's the story you tell about it.

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 4.7: "Choose not to be harmed, and you won't feel harmed." Change the story. Change the feeling.

Send this to someone hurting today.

#stoicism #marcusaurelius #mindset #stoic #resilience #healing #philosophy #dailystoic

hook: Three signs you're regulating, not suppressing.
caption:
Three signs you're regulating, not suppressing.

You can name the feeling. You feel it, then choose what to do. It passes instead of leaking out later.

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 8.47: "It is not this thing that disturbs you, but your own judgement about it." Feeling isn't the problem. Letting the first judgement drive is.

Save this for a loud day.

#stoicism #emotionalregulation #marcusaurelius #emotions #psychology
